messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Tamil, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Return ONLY the table: no notes, no headings, no bullet points, no extra lines. Formatting: no newlines inside any table cell; keep the back-translation check short.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |------------|----------------------|--------------------| | Nel | “in the” – introduces the locative PP that contains the midpoint | Locative case suffix -இல் on noun ‘நடுத்தரம்’; back‑translation: “in the middle” | | mezzo | “middle” – the spatial centre of the road | Noun ‘நடுத்தரம்’ (midpoint) in absolute form; back‑translation: “midpoint” | | del | “of the” – links “cammin” to “vita” | Genitive marker -இன் on ‘வாழ்க்கை’ to form ‘வாழ்க்கையின்’; back‑translation: “of life” | | cammin | “road” – the metaphorical path of life | Noun ‘வழி’ (road) with genitive linking to ‘வாழ்க்கை’; back‑translation: “road” | | di | “of” – genitive linking “nostra” to “vita” | Possessive suffix -உடைய attached to ‘வாழ்க்கை’; back‑translation: “of” | | nostra | “our” – collective possession of the life | Possessive pronoun ‘எங்கள்’ agreeing in number; back‑translation: “our” | | vita | “life” – the whole human existence being narrated | Noun ‘வாழ்க்கை’ in nominative; back‑translation: “life” | | mi | “myself” – marks the verb as reflexive | Reflexive clitic ‘என்னை’ as object of verb; back‑translation: “myself” | | ritrovai | “found myself” – the act of self‑discovery at a location | Verb ‘கண்டுபிடித்தேன்’ in past tense, first person, with reflexive object; back‑translation: “found myself” | | per | “within” – introduces the locative PP of the forest | Postposition ‘உள்ளில்’ or locative case -இல் on ‘காடு’; back‑translation: “within” | | una | “a” – introduces a non‑specific forest | Indefinite article expressed by lack of definiteness; noun remains singular; back‑translation: “a” | | selva | “wood” – the dark forest the narrator is in | Noun ‘காடு’ in locative case -இல்; back‑translation: “forest” | | oscura | “dark” – describes the forest’s lack of light | Adjective ‘இருண்ட’ agreeing in case with ‘காடு’; back‑translation: “dark” | | ché | “for” – signals the causal relation to the previous clause | Causal conjunction ‘ஏனெனில்’; back‑translation: “for” | | la | “the” – specifies the particular “right way” | Definite sense rendered by demonstrative ‘அந்த’; back‑translation: “the” | | diritta | “right” – denotes the correct or proper way | Adjective ‘சரியான’ agreeing with ‘வழி’; back‑translation: “right” | | via | “way” – the correct path that should be followed | Noun ‘வழி’ in nominative; back‑translation: “way” | | era | “had been” – forms the past‑perfect passive construction | Auxiliary verb ‘இருந்தது’ in imperfect past; back‑translation: “was” | | smarrita | “missed” – state of being lost or not known | Past participle adjective ‘தவறிய’ agreeing with ‘வழி’; back‑translation: “missed” |

### Step 3: Lexical Inventory & Syntactic Assembly Task: For each source line, list ALL required lexical items from Step 2, then assemble into Tamil. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Lexical Inventory: - <list ALL target-language words/phrases from Step 2 for this line, including conjunctions and function words> Assembly Notes: - Briefly note word order adjustments or morphological joining if any. Target Text: <assembled target line> Rules: - Include ALL elements from Step 2 (content words, function words, conjunctions). Missing elements cause coverage failures. - No new content words beyond Step 2 inventory. - Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. - Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous.

Source Line: Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita Lexical Inventory: - நடுத்தரம் - இல் - வாழ்க்கை - இன் - வழி - உடைய - எங்கள் Assembly Notes: - Combine “நடுத்தரம்”+“இல்” → “நடுத்தரத்தில்”; place genitive “வழியின்” before location; prepend possessive phrase “எங்கள் வாழ்க்கைஉடைய”. Target Text: எங்கள் வாழ்க்கைஉடைய வழியின் நடுத்தரத்தில்
Source Line: mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, Lexical Inventory: - என்னை - கண்டுபிடித்தேன் - காடில் - இருண்ட Assembly Notes: - Reflexive pronoun precedes verb; adjective “இருண்ட” agrees with “காடில்”; locative case already on “காடில்”. Target Text: என்னை கண்டுபிடித்தேன் இருண்ட காடில்,
Source Line: ché la diritta via era smarrita. Lexical Inventory: - ஏனெனில் - அந்த - சரியான - வழி - இருந்தது - தவறிய Assembly Notes: - Causal conjunction leads; demonstrative “அந்த” before adjective‑noun phrase; place past participle “தவறிய” before auxiliary “இருந்தது”. Target Text: ஏனெனில் அந்த சரியான வழி தவறிய இருந்தது.

### Step 4: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step3 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Meaning Drift includes wrong modifier attachment/scope. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line #: 1 - Target Text: எங்கள் வாழ்க்கைஉடைய வழியின் நடுத்தரத்தில் - Back-Translation: at the middle of the road of our life - Reference Translation: Midway upon the road of our life - Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> - Corrected Target Text:
- Line #: 2 - Target Text: என்னை கண்டுபிடித்தேன் இருண்ட காடில், - Back-Translation: I found myself in the dark forest - Reference Translation: I found myself within a dark wood, - Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> - Corrected Target Text:
- Line #: 3 - Target Text: ஏனெனில் அந்த சரியான வழி தவறிய இருந்தது. - Back-Translation: because the right way was missed - Reference Translation: for the right way had been missed. - Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> - Corrected Target Text:
``` எங்கள் வாழ்க்கைஉடைய வழியின் நடுத்தரத்தில் என்னை கண்டுபிடித்தேன் இருண்ட காடில், ஏனெனில் அந்த சரியான வழி தவறிய இருந்தது. ```
